Sir/Madam,

Please refer to the above said subject.

Z It had been clarified vide circular of even number dated 04.08.2016 that the Declaration
Form can be accepted in case of UAN based Claim Form No. 31(UAN) without attestation of the
employer. The same procedure may also be adopted for Claim Form No. 31 also.

2: In view of above, the attestation of an employer on the Declaration form would not be
required for both Form No. 31 & Form No. 31(UAN). However, the Claim Form No. 31 shall
continue to be attested by the employer.

4, This has approval of the Central P.F. Commissioner.

Yours faithfully,
